lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Independent application A: geometry and measurement

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: One reference example. Use it only if you get stuck.

items.prompt: A rental charges a $10 base fee plus $5 per hour, totaling $35. Which equation models this, and how many hours were rented?

steps: Identify what the problem is asking and which quantities, assumptions, or constraints matter.
Build and solve a model, then check the result against the context.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A diver starts at the surface (0 m) and descends 10 m, then descends another 16 m, then ascends 9 m. The dive plan assumes a depth limit of 37 m below the surface. What is the diver's final position, as a signed number of meters?
A model predicts a $800 rate will decrease by 10%. What does the model predict as the new rate?
A storage container is designed as a rectangular prism 2 ft long, 2 ft wide, and 7 ft high. What is its volume in cubic feet?
A data set has the values 34, 44, 54, 64, 74. The mean is 54. What is the mean absolute deviation (MAD), a measure of the data's uncertainty or spread?
A student claims a box that is 3 by 2 by 4 units has a volume of 6 cubic units. Evaluate the claim.
choices: No; the volume is 8 cubic units, not 6.
No; the volume is 24 cubic units, not 6.
Yes; the volume is 6 cubic units.
Cannot be determined from the given information.

items.prompt: A rental company charges a $1 base fee plus $5 per hour. A customer's total bill was $31. Which equation models this situation, and how many hours were rented?

A diver starts at the surface (0 m) and descends 13 m, then descends another 26 m, then ascends 31 m. The dive plan assumes a depth limit of 54 m below the surface. What is the diver's final position, as a signed number of meters?
A model predicts a $80 rate will increase by 25%. What does the model predict as the new rate?

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Mastery check. Work without help, then stop and hand this section in.

items.prompt: A storage container is designed as a rectangular prism 9 ft long, 7 ft wide, and 4 ft high. What is its volume in cubic feet?
A data set has the values 2, 17, 32, 47, 62. The mean is 32. What is the mean absolute deviation (MAD), a measure of the data's uncertainty or spread?
A student claims a box that is 3 by 7 by 3 units has a volume of 13 cubic units. Evaluate the claim.
choices: Cannot be determined from the given information.
No; the volume is 14 cubic units, not 13.
No; the volume is 63 cubic units, not 13.
Yes; the volume is 13 cubic units.
